evals.prompt: Design a CI/CD pipeline for our FastAPI application using GitHub Actions. It should run linting, unit tests, integration tests, security scanning, build a Docker image, and deploy to staging then production with manual approval.
evals.expected_output: Proposes multi-stage GitHub Actions workflow with parallelized test jobs, Docker build and push, staged deployment with approval gates.
assertions: Designs a multi-stage pipeline with parallel execution of independent jobs (lint, unit tests, security scan)
Includes Docker image build and push to a container registry
Implements staged deployment with manual approval gate between staging and production

evals.prompt: Our CI pipeline takes 28 minutes to complete. The breakdown: 2 min checkout, 8 min dependency install, 10 min tests, 5 min Docker build, 3 min deploy. Optimize it to under 10 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Proposes dependency caching, test parallelization, Docker layer caching, and identifies the dependency install as the main bottleneck.
assertions: Recommends dependency caching to reduce the 8-minute install step
Proposes test parallelization or selective test running to reduce the 10-minute test step
Suggests Docker layer caching or multi-stage builds to speed up the 5-minute build

evals.prompt: Implement a GitOps workflow for our Kubernetes deployments. We currently deploy manually with kubectl apply. We want declarative, version-controlled, and automatically synced deployments.
evals.expected_output: Proposes ArgoCD or Flux, designs repository structure for manifests, defines sync policies, includes drift detection and rollback strategy.
assertions: Recommends a GitOps tool (ArgoCD or Flux) with justification
Designs a Git repository structure for Kubernetes manifests
Defines sync policies with automatic drift detection and remediation

evals.prompt: Design a canary deployment strategy for our API service. We want to route 5% of traffic to the new version, monitor error rates and latency for 15 minutes, then gradually increase to 100% or rollback automatically.
evals.expected_output: Proposes progressive canary with traffic splitting, defines success metrics and thresholds, includes automated rollback triggers.
assertions: Designs a progressive canary rollout starting at 5% with defined increment steps
Defines specific success metrics (error rate, latency thresholds) for promotion decisions
Includes automated rollback triggers when metrics exceed thresholds

evals.prompt: Our deployment pipeline has no rollback mechanism. Last week a bad deploy caused 2 hours of downtime because the team had to manually rebuild and redeploy the previous version. Design a robust rollback strategy.
evals.expected_output: Proposes versioned container images, instant rollback via previous image tag, database migration rollback strategy, and automated health-check-based rollback.
assertions: Designs instant rollback using versioned container images or deployment revisions
Addresses database migration rollback with backward-compatible migration strategy
Proposes automated health-check-based rollback that triggers without manual intervention

should_trigger: Design a CI/CD pipeline for our FastAPI app with GitHub Actions
Our CI pipeline takes too long, help us optimize it
Implement a GitOps workflow for our Kubernetes deployments
Design a canary deployment strategy for our API service
We need a rollback mechanism for our deployment pipeline

Review this React component for accessibility issues
Fine-tune an LLM for educational question answering
